data.one_liner: A collection of searching, sorting, and string metric algorithms.
data.what_it_does: Provides various sorting algorithms (such as bubble sort, merge sort, quick sort), searching algorithms (binary and linear search variants), and string metric algorithms (like Levenshtein distance, Jaccard index, and Hamming distance).
use_when: You need standard computer science algorithms like sorting or binary search in Dart.
You require string similarity or distance metrics like Levenshtein or Jaccard index.
avoid_when: You are dealing with high-level app state or UI components.
You require standard library collections that already satisfy your requirements.
strengths: Includes benchmarks and tests for its algorithms.
Wide range of sorting, searching, and string distance metrics.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused strictly on basic algorithms.
No UI or platform-specific utility support.
